'''Choka Skell''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warrior]] assigned to [[Master Shaper]] [[Nei Rin]] at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Temple]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="LE CG" /> Skell and [[Liaan Lah]] accompanied Nei Rin on a fact-finding mission on the sabotage of the [[Ossus Project]], only to return and find that all the Yuuzhan Vong at the [[temple]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]].
